note: Chi phi nhap tay theo thang (USD/thang), bang P&L tu rai deu theo ngay trong thang. Muc G&A (tren EBITDA): salary = luong gian tiep (van hanh, quan ly); software = phan mem & cong cu (KHONG gom Snowball $350 va Klaviyo - da co san); office = van phong & van hanh; accounting = ke toan & phap ly; insurance = bao hiem; other = khac. Muc duoi EBITDA: depreciation = khau hao & phan bo (khuon, thiet bi, phan mem mua dut); interest = lai vay & chi phi tai chinh (am neu lai tien gui > lai vay); income_tax = thue TNDN theo thang (bo trong/null de bang uoc tinh theo tax_rate x loi nhuan truoc thue duong; 0 = khong co thue). Thang chua co dong rieng se lay theo thang gan nhat da nhap. Them thang moi = them mot dong "YYYY-MM": {...}.
